method: Screenshots from the final real Chromium run; desktop list and mobile detail were inspected manually, and the mobile scenario asserts document width does not exceed viewport.
assertions: The list displays the newly submitted request and server status
The detail displays server-verified staff eligibility
The history contains submit, clarification and resubmit events
The 390px layout has no horizontal overflow
Live UI does not expose the deferred D3 transfer action
limitations: Screenshot evidence is retained in ignored local E2E artifacts; this report records hashes and automated layout assertions rather than pixel-diff coverage.
